page.layout: One page of text, single column of italic verse at top, followed by a centred-right block of roman type (dedicatory inscription) below; catchword "DIS-" at lower right.

p.i: Exprimis hâc Summâ. Licet hæc permulta requirant
Magnum opus, at tamen id pagina parva refert.
Et, quod miramur, varia arma dolosa retundis,
Atque hostes proprio sic jugulas gladio.
Cætera quæ promunt breviter solideque refellis,
Quin simul incautos hos superare doces.
Sic igitur tuto, te Duce, scire licet.
Nunc Summas Scotista tenax, Thomistaque essset,
Sunt miseræ, elumbes, vana, sunt denique falsa,
Quæis tua non unis conferenda modis.
Hâc gravior, brevior, succinctior, aptior haud est,
Solaque, quam scribis, Summa probanda venit.
Ut Symmystatibi, sic mihi testis, erit.

main_text.p: JACOBUS BASELIUS, Ecclesiastes Kerckwervensis, L. M. Q. C. die Maji III. Anni cIↄ Iↄ c LIV. cum Summam ipsam, cum summâ voluptate, nec minori utilitate, legisset.

page.notes: Verse lines are italic; the dedicatory block is roman, set at right. Several words in the verse are partly illegible due to print damage and spotting; the Roman date is rendered as printed (cIↄ Iↄ c LIV = MDCLIV). Some readings such as "Quæis", "Symmystatibi", "Summistaprobo" and "Kerckwervensis" are doubtful.
